sharing.reason: The Artifact tool cannot change sharing. The publish result says sharing is done from the page's Share menu. Root handles sharing after this publish.
sharing.remaining_step: Open the URL while signed in to claude.ai as the owner, open the page's Share menu, and set access to anyone with the link.

corrections_applied.query_names: q01 Publication counts, q02 Topic statistics, q03 Author output, q04 International collaboration, q05 One-hop citations, q06 Two-hop citations, q07 Citations by year. Used in all charts, controls and copy, with q numbers as secondary labels. Figure 2 widened its label column, raised its phone-layout breakpoint to 720 px and gave phone rows a separate line for the speed ratio.
corrections_applied.join_algorithms: auto and parallel_hash labelled as join algorithms, as confirmed.
method_notes: ClickHouse: preloaded normalized selected-column tables, timed with FORMAT Null, separate JSON correctness export.
Athena: results materialized to S3, CSV download excluded.
All 99 full typed multiset comparisons matched.
All five tuning arms, including a second control that is not graphed, matched 838,464 output rows.
parallel_hash24 still had aggregation spill; preaggregate12 had none in all 3 runs.
All cohorts include 119,129,660 authors plus fixed institutions, sources and topics, so raw GB is total input, not works only.
Host m7g.8xlarge 32 vCPU, 128 GiB; Docker 18 CPU, 50 GiB.
No claim of full-corpus or minimum-resource sufficiency.
corrections_applied.figure_2_ruler: Now draws one bar for the selected cohort at its own percentage on a track that is 100% of Works. Nested cohorts are no longer drawn together. The track label changed from 'Rest of Works: untested' to 'Outside this cohort', because for smaller cohorts that remainder includes tested larger cohorts.
corrections_applied.cpu_and_memory: CPU stays 'Average busy cores out of 18'. Query peak memory stays labelled as not container RSS and excluding file cache. The core-seconds figures derived in version 1 were removed.
corrections_applied.other_copy: The tuning intro now says the arms differed in query limits, join algorithm or SQL. Pre-aggregated SQL's memory peak is described as the lowest of the graphed arms, because the second control is not graphed.

known_gaps.rendered_preview: This session offered no preview or screenshot tool, and neither version has been rendered or had its script run here. Root will run Playwright and independent CLI QA.
known_gaps.version_1_ruler_finding: From reading the CSS, version 1's bars were absolutely positioned at left 0, so they overlapped and did not sum to 8.62% on screen. This was not checked in a browser. The ruler was still replaced as instructed, because overlapping nested cohorts was misleading.
